```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  have h3 : b ≥ 3 := le_of_gt hb
  have h5 : a ≥ b + 1 := le_of_gt ha
  have h6 : a ≥ 4 := lt_trans (lt_add_right zero_lt_one ha) (le_refl 4)
  have h7 : b ≤ 12 / a := mul_le_mul_left h5 (le_refl 12)
  have h8 : b ≤ 3 := le_trans h7 (div_le_div_right h6 (le_refl 12))
  have h9 : b = 3 := eq_of_le_antisymm h3 h8
  rw [h9 at h]
  exact eq_of_mul_left_inj (ne_of_gt ha) h
```
